Subject: RFP: request for supplier roster + regional access controls

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for submitting the initial RFP materials. As part of Montclair's risk evaluation we need a consolidated supplier roster and a short attestation covering:

- Which cloud regions Redwood uses for hosted instances and backups (US/EU/APAC split)
- Any subprocessors with cross-border access to customer data and the legal basis for that access
- KMS key ownership model and whether customer keys are supported (BYOK)
- Controls around operator access for incident response (bastion logs, 2-person reviews)

Can you provide a single document or package we can upload into our vendor portal? We have an internal deadline of Friday 2028-04-15.

Appreciate a short email and any attachments you can share today/tomorrow so we can move to the security review stage.

Best,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager
Montclair Bank

Subject: Re: RFP: request for supplier roster + regional access controls

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. Attaching our vendor roster CSV and a region/access spreadsheet to start (see attachments). Highlights up front:

- Primary serving regions: us-west-2, us-east-1. Disaster recovery and backups: eu-west-1 (for customers who opt in to multi-region) and ap-southeast-1 for APAC enterprise customers.
- Cross-border access: a small set of operator accounts in our Global Support Team have read-only diagnostic access; no automated transfer of customer content outside the customer's selected region unless explicitly enabled. We call this out in the roster.
- KMS model: we support Redwood-managed keys by default and BYOK for Dedicated/Private deployments; BYOK customers keep control of root key in their KMS, and we only receive wrapped data keys for inference.
- Operator access controls: just-in-time (JIT) access, approval workflows, session recording, and 2-person escalation for privileged actions.

I've asked KarThik and Ben to confirm a couple of architecture points below. We'll follow up with the KMS diagram and a formal attestation doc you can upload to the portal (DocuSign link to follow).

Attachments: 20280410-redwood-vendor-roster.csv, 20280411-region-access-matrix.xlsx

Thanks,

Elena / Rachel — quick technical clarifications:

1) BYOK flow: For Dedicated/Private we integrate with customer KMS (AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault / GCP KMS). We never store unwrapped customer master keys. For hosted customers who opt into customer-managed keys, we only receive encrypted/wrapped data keys and ephemeral credentials for runtime usage; the wrapping key remains customer-owned. I can add the exact sequence diagram to the KMS PDF.

2) Operator boundary: Our Global Support Team members who may need cross-region diagnostic access are bound by two constraints: (a) access must be approved via our JIT gateway with a named approver, and (b) the session is recorded and retained for 180 days. For EU customers subject to data residency, cross-region access is disabled by default unless a contractual exception exists.

I'll produce a short KMS architecture diagram and a one-page attestation for the document pack.

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
